descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Peridot Flame' Rare Peridot Flame Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Peridot Flame' has a light peach spring color maturing to an olive green. Fall color can range from a pure yellow to an orange-red 'Peridot Flame' is a vigorous grower that may reach 10-12 ft in 10 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Peridot Flame'，珍稀日本枫，适生区 5-9。 ‘Peridot Flame’ 春季叶色为浅桃色，随后成熟为橄榄绿色。 秋季叶色可从纯黄色变化到橙红色。 ‘Peridot Flame’ 长势旺盛，10 年可达 10-12 英尺。 带有 MrMaple 标识的照片
